transcript:
Meeting header:
- Date/Time: 2027-11-30 16:00 PST
- Duration: 46 minutes
- Attendees: Samir (Redwood AE), Lena (Redwood SE), Marcus (Redwood CSM); Aisha, Ben, Danielle, Omar (Halo)

Auto-summary: short check-in ahead of renewal to discuss Dedicated capacity, extra regions, pricing and procurement path.

[00:00] Samir: thanks everyone for joining, quick agenda - renewal options, three region Dedicated ask, benchmarks and next steps. how's everyone doing?
[00:12] Aisha: good, thanks. we've been ramping up usage, so we wanted to talk renewal and adding capacity esp for eu-west.
[00:20] Lena: great, can you remind us of current traffic patterns and p95 latency targets?
[00:27] Danielle: yeah, most traffic is pacific coast, about 40% eu, rest APAC. target p95 < 350ms for user-facing prompts, and lower for triage flows.
[00:40] Ben: also we need data residency for eu patients, logs must stay in eu region, and SOC2 evidence for audits.
[00:50] Samir: totally. we typically do Dedicated pools per region; we can reserve capacity in us-west, eu-west, ap-southeast. that'll give you predictable throughput and isolated KV cache.
[01:04] Danielle: when you say isolated KV cache, is that automatically kept in region? any cross-region replication?
[01:12] Lena: good question - by default cache and tokenized caches are colocated with Dedicated pool; cross-region replication is opt-in. we can keep EU-only for patient data.
[01:25] Omar: on pricing: what's the delta vs our current hosted usage? we care about steady monthly cost and burst handling.
[01:32] Samir: so two parts - committed capacity monthly and a burst buffer. for a 3-region Dedicated plan with your current qps we'd estimate base commit of X GPUs - we'll send detailed sheet. ballpark delta is ~2.1x of current hosted spend but with much lower per-token variance and predictable latency.
[01:55] Aisha: okay can you put that in writing, and include annual vs monthly commit discounts?
[02:02] Samir: yes, we'll send a formal proposal. Marcus: anything on onboarding or timeline?
[02:10] Marcus: typically 4-6 weeks for Dedicated onboarding once signatures and region capacity are confirmed; includes network setup, VPC peering or private link, KMS integration, and test run.
[02:21] Ben: what's the network setup - do we need a VPN or do you support VPC peering?
[02:27] Lena: we support VPC peering, PrivateLink, and on-prem connectors. for EU restrictions we recommend peering with eu-west cluster and using customer-managed KMS.
[02:40] Danielle: curious about fallback - if a region is saturated do you route to other regions? that could violate residency.
[02:48] Samir: by policy you can set strict residency so requests from EU never fall back to non-EU pools. we also have cost-aware routing for other traffic classes.
[02:58] Omar: procurement concern - contract length, automatic renewals? we prefer 12 month with option to extend; can you do amendments vs new SOWs?
[03:06] Samir: yes amendments are standard. we can add region addendum and capacity addendum. we'll include that in the draft.
[03:15] Aisha: about SLAs - do you guarantee p99? we need something for clinical-critical flows.
[03:21] Lena: our Dedicated SLA covers uptime and latency for specified routes. we can discuss specific p99 targets for your critical flows; note that p99 is sensitive to model size and sequence length, so we'll capture in the rollout plan.
[03:38] Danielle: perfect. next, performance benchmark - can Redwood run a perf test in our staging with redwood-optimized-4B? we want p50/p95/p99 and token-cost numbers.
[03:48] Lena: yes, we'll run in your staging. we'll need a service account and small test dataset and an agreed prompt set to mirror production.
[03:56] Ben: security docs - can you send SOC2, ISO certs, and a diagram of audit logs?
[04:03] Samir: will do. we'll attach SOC2 report and an architecture diagram; logs retention can be configured per region and we support customer-managed KMS.
[04:12] Omar: if we sign on by mid-December, when can we expect Dedicated live?
[04:16] Marcus: signing mid-December + 4-6 weeks -> late January to early February live.
[04:23] Aisha: ok that aligns with our Q1 rollout.
[04:26] Samir: cool. any blockers on your side?
[04:28] Aisha: procurement needs to see contract + redlines, and we need the pricing broken out per region and burst.
[04:35] Samir: understood. we'll send detailed pricing and amendment.
[04:38] Danielle: one more - are there recommended quantization/instance types for lower unit cost? we've seen big wins in other vendors.
[04:46] Lena: yes, Redwood Optimize will recommend quantization profiles and batching configs based on your workload; we'll include initial recommendations and expected cost delta.
[04:56] Ben: also can we get a short run comparing hosted vs dedicated cost per 1M tokens? numbers help procurement.
[05:02] Samir: yes, we'll include per-1M-token comparison and show sensitivity to batch size and sequence length.
[05:08] Omar: procurement timeline - we aim to have PO ready by Dec 7 if pricing acceptable.
[05:12] Samir: great, we'll target sending materials Dec 3.
[05:16] Marcus: action items - Lena will set up perf run, Samir will send pricing and contract amendment, Aisha and Omar will confirm internal approvals and PO timing.
[05:28] Danielle: thanks, that works. question - any special notes about logs and retention so our privacy team is happy?
[05:34] Lena: logs can be retained in-region and we can mask PII; we also support audit exports to your SIEM.
[05:41] Aisha: ok good.
[05:44] Samir: cool, thanks everyone - we will follow up with materials and schedule the benchmark.
[05:50] Omar: thanks all.

End of transcript.

Notes on transcription: occasional mis-hearings (e g Redwood Dedicated transcribed as "Redwood Dedicatd" in parts), and speaker overlap around 02:00-03:30 where many participants chimed in. Transcript is verbatim-ish, not cleaned for grammar.
